resources.string: Listens only for screen state and physical controller input, then uses a full-screen overlay to prevent accidental input. It does not read content from other apps.
After waking the screen, press the same supported controller button three times or swipe with one finger to enter the system.
Supports ABXY, D-pad, R1/R2, L1/L2, Select, and Start
The app is already allowed to ignore battery optimization
Unable to open battery optimization settings
Customize the lock screen background, center icon, and prompt text colors. Changes apply the next time the lock screen appears.
Unable to read the selected image
Unable to open screen lock settings

1. Set the system screen lock to “None”
2. Enable “TriplePress Unlock Service” in Accessibility Settings
3. Tap “Allow Background Use” and confirm the system prompt
4. Test it and confirm controller buttons can unlock the screen

Touch unlock: Swipe far enough in any direction with one finger. A tap or small movement will not unlock.\n\nThis app only prevents accidental input. It does not replace a PIN, password, or encrypted system lock. It does not read screen content, access the network, poll in the background, or hold a wake lock.
